author: Tyler Valenti
text:
Super friendly dudes, got us on the schedule fast and were very reasonable on price.

Good old fashion New England business that treats people well. Fast, clean work and very communicative. Would recommend

author: Rachel
text: We cant thank Stone Septic enough for saving the day with our septic system repair. They responded quickly, diagnosed the issue, and got the problem fixed fast with excellent workmanship and attention to detail. The entire process was smooth and professional.

author: cindi ray
text: Highly recommend Stones Septic, Honest to the core, friendly and they look out for the best interest of the customer. Both Brian and his son Jeremy did the best they could do with my 30 yr old system. Should be good far another 30 yrs! I will not hesitate to call or recommend them any day of the week.

author: Ron & Lyne Vishaway
text: We strongly recommend Stones' Septic Service in Swanzey, NH. Their team was professional and delivered excellent service. Brian and Jeremy were courteous, knowledgeable, and very helpful.

author: Carrie
text: Emergency septic issue 2 other companies were not able to come until “sometime next” and “it will be a few weeks trucks are winterized”.  Call to stones went out at 7 am all pumped out and back up cleared by 9:30 am. You guys are great thank you so much!!!
